<reason>Side B made the clash easier to decide: undonated remains cannot stay in institutional custody because researchers, or even an independent board, say study still matters. A’s presumption-plus-exception was careful, but it never escaped B’s live attacks that process is delay, a hearing over descendant refusal is possession, and burial already accepts some unanswered questions. B answered pressure directly, handled disagreement by returning first, and held the hard case without evasion.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s Rebuttal 2 (A1–A2): return first so descendants decide among themselves, and “Yes. Immediate return even then,” recasting CON’s otherwise-lost-evidence case as still illegitimate custody.</best_rebuttal>
